name: MuViS
description: Virtual sensing aims to infer hard-to-measure quantities from accessible measurements and is central to perception and control in physical systems. Despite rapid progress from first-principle and hybrid models to modern data-driven methods research remains siloed, leaving no established default approach that transfers across processes, modalities, and sensing configurations. We introduce MuViS, a domain-agnostic benchmarking suite for multimodal virtual sensing that consolidates diverse datasets into a unified interface for standardized preprocessing and evaluation.
